svg.title: Frame-time graph before and after
svg.text: One recording, 300 frames: the average hides the spikes
Each thin bar is one frame. Night city level, 5,000 zombies, frame cap off. Example numbers.
all 5,000 zombies re-path on the same frame
5 spikes of 66 ms = 5 freezes the player feels
Read the worst frames (P99, max, count over budget), not the average.
